name: Q1K3
tagline: A shotgun, two torch-lit halls, in a GIF. No server.
description:
This is Q1K3 in a GIF. There is no jam page, no install, and no server. Open the file and you are in the halls. Close it, come back — how the look feels, and which map you reached, live in the file.

You wake up in a brown stone hall with a shotgun in your hands and something waiting around the corner. Grunts, ogres, a hound that runs at you. Doors that need a key. A nailgun and a handful of grenades if you live long enough to pick them up. Two maps, then the end.

On a phone the left thumb walks and the right thumb looks; tap to shoot, jump with the button. On a computer it is WASD, the mouse, and a click.

Send the invite and extra people appear in the same halls. The room is the link.

An unofficial port of Q1K3 by phoboslab. Music by Andy Lösch.
